 Serial numbers in Chinese filings reveal that Nvidia's restricted Blackwell chips were installed at a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang and Megaspeed   —  A pair of Chinese firms installed Nvidia Corp.'s powerful Blackwell semiconductors in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang …
